activity.role: Chicago organized-crime syndicate leader during Prohibition
activity.notes: FBI dates Capone's takeover from Johnny Torrio to 1925 and his federal tax-evasion conviction to October 1931. 1925–1931 is the historic underworld leadership period, not rule over a US state or a claim that FBI originated from Capone; do not blur criminal syndicate with a sovereign Polity. Commerce is the closest existing Domain v2 for organized illicit bootlegging/financial operations and denotes no legitimacy. Alias Alphonse Gabriel Capone/Scarface are one Person.
